rules.description: dotfiles: Glove80 only: swap Command and Option
dotfiles: Glove80 in browsers: give the Alt key back its Option chords
dotfiles: Glove80 outside VS Code: the notification chords
dotfiles: Glove80 in VS Code: give the Alt key back ctrl+alt+c
dotfiles: the media row on a bare press, except F7
dotfiles: F7 is previous-track, except in terminals
dotfiles: Ctrl+letter to Cmd+letter (not in terminals)
dotfiles: Ctrl+Left/Right word navigation (not in terminals)
dotfiles: Ctrl+Backspace/Delete deletes a word (not in terminals)
dotfiles: Ctrl+Home/End jumps to document start/end
dotfiles: Home/End go to line start/end (not in terminals or VS Code)
dotfiles: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown cycle tabs
dotfiles: Browser chords: address bar, bookmarks, history, downloads, devtools, source
